status: FROZEN BEFORE READING ANY SAMPLED ROW. Locate output only (ID, date, phrase classes, length).

locate.locate_level_fact: the WHAT-IT-CHANGES / DOES-NOT-CHANGE template occurs in every row R-81..R-91 and in no earlier row

sampling_rule.non-template stratum: most distinct classes (R-53) + earliest with NOT-AUTHORIZE (R-47) + earliest unused with NEITHER (R-66)
sampling_rule.rationale: operation unknown before reading, so diversity is proxied by stratum (template era vs before), date spread and phrase class

encoding_per_case.concept_separation: route != operation != kind != effect != state coordinate != relation != invariant != guard; each non-effect is tagged as candidate STATE-COORDINATE | RELATION | INVARIANT/GUARD, never decided from one case

frame_fit_rule.FRAME-FIT: the row maps to an M0 operation, and every stated change lies in its M0 frame and no stated preserved coordinate is in the frame's forced-change set
frame_fit_rule.FRAME-CONTRADICTION: the row maps to an M0 operation and states a change to an M0 coordinate outside that operation's frame
frame_fit_rule.PARTIAL-FIT: some stated changes fit, others concern coordinates M0 does not have
frame_fit_rule.NOT-MODELLED: the operation has no M0 counterpart (a vocabulary gap, never a contradiction)
frame_fit_rule.UNKNOWN: the operation or its changes are not stated

frame_structure_rule: a row EXHIBITS FRAME STRUCTURE iff it states >= 1 change AND >= 1 explicit preservation/non-effect about the same act
precision: each matched phrase-class occurrence is labelled TRUE-FRAME (states a preservation/non-effect of the act) or FALSE (other use); precision = TRUE/matched per class
path_dependence: per case: does the row state that history does/does not alter future permissions?
no_inference: silence is NOT-RECORDED; a complete frame is never inferred from silence; M0 unchanged
